escenas.prompt: Static camera with a very slow, subtle push-in toward the dark front porch at 2 a.m. On the walkway right next to the large dark potted palm, the small low dark animal shape shifts slightly and its two tiny reflective eyes blink once. Palm fronds sway gently in a light night breeze. Porch lights stay OFF, windows stay dark, the bench is empty. Nobody around. Nothing else moves.
Static close-up at night. The blue light ring around the video doorbell's camera pulses brighter twice, as if it just detected motion. Nothing else moves. Static camera, no zoom.

Static camera. Quiet hospital corridor during the night shift, dim calm lights. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, holds her phone; it buzzes, she stops and looks down at it, slightly curious. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.

Static camera. Quiet hospital corridor during the night shift, dim calm lights. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, taps her phone screen twice with her thumb, then tilts her head, waiting. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.

Static camera on the dark front porch at night. Suddenly the porch wall lantern and the porch ceiling light switch ON, flooding the porch and walkway with warm light and revealing that the small dark shape next to the potted palm is a small real raccoon, which freezes in surprise. The raccoon keeps the same small realistic size. The sky stays dark night.

Static camera, wide shot of the lit front porch at night. The small raccoon on the walkway trots steadily from LEFT to RIGHT, parallel to the front of the house, across the walkway and the lawn in front of the porch, and exits the frame at the right edge. It stays at the same distance from the camera the whole time and keeps the same small realistic size: it never walks toward the camera and never gets bigger. Natural real raccoon gait with its ringed tail low. Porch lights stay on; the porch is empty afterwards. Nothing else moves.
